scale: demo: 2 tenants, ~15 messages, ~6 attachments (<= 1.2 MB), private containers on one machine

backupMethod.postgres: pg_dump -U postgres -d wardenx | gzip, as deploy/production/reseed-demo.sh runs it (logical, single snapshot, no WAL archive, no PITR)
backupMethod.objectStore: tar of the stopped MinIO /data (closest real mechanism; production has NO object-store backup)
backupMethod.coordination: writes quiesced between the two (production has no coordination between them)

checks.name: row counts per M36 table equal the backup-time counts
RLS flags, policies, grants and triggers per M36 table equal the source
audit_event count and M4 hash chain per org equal the backup-time source
every non-destroyed attachment row has its object present and byte-identical (size, sha256, etag)
destroyed attachment rows have no object
no orphan objects (every stored object is referenced by a row)
restored DB: wardenx_app logs in, is NOT superuser/BYPASSRLS
RLS holds after restore: no tenant context reads nothing; own tenant reads rows; cross-tenant reads nothing
checks.detail: no-context=0, A->A=10, A->B message=0 attachment=0 channel=0 audit=0

checks.name: message and message_revision body hashes verify (runHashVerifyForOrg, full coverage)
